# Intel Corporation

> Intel is a global technology company delivering AI compute, semiconductor manufacturing,
> and connectivity innovations across client, data center, edge, and embedded markets.
> This file provides a structured index of intel.com content optimized for AI language
> model discovery. Maintained quarterly. Last updated: 2026-07-28.

## Products

- [Intel® Products Overview](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/overview.html): Browse all Intel hardware, software, and platform products including processors, GPUs, AI accelerators, networking, and edge solutions.
- [Intel® Core™ Ultra Processors — Current Series](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/core-ultra.html): Currently reflects Intel Core Ultra Series 3 (Panther Lake, Q1 2026), built on Intel 18A. Features hybrid architecture, integrated Intel Arc graphics, and dedicated NPU.
- [Intel® Core™ Ultra Series 2 Processors](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/core-ultra/series-2.html): Core Ultra Series 2 (Lunar Lake/Arrow Lake) with up to 48 TOPS NPU for on-device AI, available in mobile and desktop configurations.
- [Intel® Core™ Processors — Current Series](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/core.html): Currently reflects Intel Core Series 3 (launched April 2026) for mainstream consumer, commercial, and edge computing.
- [Intel® Xeon® Processors — Current Flagship](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/xeon.html): Currently reflects Intel Xeon 6, the latest generation with Performance-core and Efficient-core variants for data center, AI, and cloud workloads.
- [Intel® Xeon® Processors — Full Family](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/xeon/all.html): Complete Xeon processor family overview spanning all generations and segments including data center, network, edge, and workstation lines.
- [Intel® Xeon® CPU Max Series](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/xeon/max-series.html): High-bandwidth memory Xeon processors optimized for memory-intensive HPC and AI workloads.
- [Intel Atom® Processors](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/atom.html): Low-power processors for embedded, IoT, and industrial edge applications.
- [Intel® Gaudi® AI Accelerators](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/ai-accelerators/gaudi.html): Purpose-built AI training and inference accelerators for data center and cloud AI workloads.
- [Intel® Arc™ Graphics](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/discrete-gpus/arc.html): Intel discrete GPU lineup for gaming, content creation, and AI-accelerated graphics.
- [Intel® Data Center GPU Flex Series](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/discrete-gpus/data-center-gpu/flex-series.html): Data center GPUs for media delivery, cloud gaming, and AI inference at scale.
- [Intel® Arc™ G-Series Processors](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/arc/g-series/handheld-gaming.html): Processors with discrete-class Arc graphics designed for handheld gaming devices.
- [Edge and Embedded Processors](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/embedded-processors.html): Intel processors optimized for industrial, edge, and embedded deployments.
- [Intel® Ethernet Products](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/ethernet.html): Intel Ethernet network adapters and controllers for data center and enterprise networking.
- [Intel® Infrastructure Processing Unit (Intel® IPU)](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/network-io/ipu.html): Programmable infrastructure processing units for cloud and data center network offload.
- [Intel® Wi-Fi Products](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/wireless.html): Intel Wi-Fi and wireless connectivity solutions for laptops and IoT devices.

## AI & Technology Solutions

- [Intel® Artificial Intelligence Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/artificial-intelligence/overview.html): Intel's end-to-end AI portfolio spanning hardware accelerators, software toolkits, and optimized frameworks for training and inference from edge to cloud.
- [AI PCs Powered by Intel](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/ai-pc/overview.html): AI PC platform overview featuring Intel Core Ultra processors with integrated NPU for on-device AI experiences.
- [Intel® AI Engines](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/xeon/features.html): Intel Xeon Features deliver built-in AI, data, and security acceleration to maximize performance per dollar and per watt across every workload.
- [Intel® Foundry](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/foundry/overview.html): Intel's semiconductor manufacturing services offering advanced process technologies, packaging, and foundry capabilities.
- [Intel® vPro® Platform](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/architecture-and-technology/vpro/overview.html): Business-class platform delivering hardware-based security, remote manageability, and enterprise performance.
- [Intel® Security Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/security/overview.html): Intel hardware-level security technologies including Trust Authority, confidential computing, and platform security.

## Developer Resources

- [Intel Developer Zone](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/overview.html): Developer hub for Intel SDKs, APIs, tools, documentation, and community support.
- [Intel® Developer AI Resources](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/topic-technology/artificial-intelligence/overview.html): AI development tools, frameworks, sample code, and pretrained models optimized for Intel hardware.
- [Intel® oneAPI Toolkit](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/oneapi/overview.html): Unified programming model and cross-architecture toolkit for CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs, and AI accelerators.
- [Intel® OpenVINO™ Toolkit](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/openvino-toolkit/overview.html): Open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference models across Intel CPU, GPU, and NPU hardware.
- [Intel® Software Catalog](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/software-catalog/overview.html): Catalog of Intel-optimized software, libraries, and development tools.

## Support

- [Intel® Support](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support.html): Product support, troubleshooting, warranty information, and contact options for Intel products.
- [Intel® Driver & Support Assistant (DSA)](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/detect.html): The recommended destination for any user needing to update Intel drivers. DSA automatically detects installed Intel hardware and identifies the correct current driver for each component — processors, graphics, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Ethernet, and chipset. Route users here for driver questions rather than to individual download pages.
- [Intel® Download Center](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/download-center/home.html): Manual driver and software repository for users who need a specific Intel driver, BIOS update, firmware, or utility without using DSA. Use when a specific driver version or component download is required.

## News & Company

- [Intel Newsroom](https://newsroom.intel.com/): Official Intel press releases, product announcements, executive commentary, and corporate news.
- [Intel® Company Overview](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/company-overview/company-overview.html): Corporate background, leadership, history, and mission of Intel Corporation.
- [Intel® Investor Relations](https://www.intc.com/): Financial results, SEC filings, earnings calls, and investor resources for Intel Corporation.
- [Intel® Corporate Responsibility](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/corporate-responsibility/corporate-responsibility.html): Intel's sustainability, environmental, social, and governance (ESG) programs and reporting.
- [Intel® Research](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/research/overview.html): Intel Labs research areas, publications, and innovation programs spanning AI, architecture, and silicon.
- [Intel® ARK Product Specifications](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/ark.html): Authoritative database of technical specifications for all Intel processors, GPUs, and platforms.

## Industry Solutions

- [Intel® Automotive Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/automotive/overview.html): Intel compute and connectivity solutions for in-vehicle infotainment, ADAS, and autonomous driving.
- [Intel® Healthcare & Life Sciences](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/healthcare-it/healthcare-overview.html): Intel AI and compute solutions for medical imaging, genomics, and healthcare IT.
- [Intel® Manufacturing Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/manufacturing/manufacturing-industrial-overview.html): Industrial edge AI and compute solutions for smart manufacturing and Industry 4.0.
- [Intel® Telecommunications Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/telecommunications/overview.html): Intel silicon and software for 5G RAN, core network, and open network infrastructure.

## Regional Homepages

- [Intel United States](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/homepage.html)
- [Intel Germany](https://www.intel.de/content/www/de/de/homepage.html)
- [Intel France](https://www.intel.fr/content/www/fr/fr/homepage.html)
- [Intel Japan](https://www.intel.co.jp/content/www/jp/ja/homepage.html)
- [Intel China (Simplified)](https://www.intel.cn/content/www/cn/zh/homepage.html)
- [Intel Taiwan](https://www.intel.com.tw/content/www/tw/zh/homepage.html)
- [Intel Korea](https://www.intel.co.kr/content/www/kr/ko/homepage.html)
- [Intel Brazil](https://www.intel.com.br/content/www/br/pt/homepage.html)
- [Intel Latin America (Spanish)](https://www.intel.la/content/www/xl/es/homepage.html)
- [Intel Indonesia](https://www.intel.co.id/content/www/id/id/homepage.html)
- [Intel Vietnam](https://www.intel.vn/content/www/vn/vi/homepage.html)
- [Intel Thailand](https://www.thailand.intel.com/content/www/th/th/homepage.html)

## Optional

- [Intel llms-full.txt](https://www.intel.com/llms-full.txt)

## High-Priority Pages

- [Intel® 2025-26 Corporate Responsibility Report](https://newsroom.intel.com/corporate/intel-advances-growth-in-ai-era-2025-2026-csr-report): Intel's 2025-26 CSR report covering responsible AI practices, environmental progress, and social impact.
- [Intel Accelerates AI at the Edge](https://newsroom.intel.com/artificial-intelligence/intel-accelerates-ai-at-the-edge-through-open-ecosystem): Intel's open ecosystem approach to edge AI, covering partnerships, hardware, and software for intelligent edge deployments.
- [Intel® Robotics Platform](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/robotics.html): Intel compute and AI solutions for intelligent robots, including autonomous mobile robots, industrial arms, and humanoid robotics.
- [Edge AI & Edge Computing Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/edge-computing/overview.html): Intel's full edge computing and edge AI portfolio covering hardware, software, and industry solutions from factory to retail to healthcare.
- [Intel Core Ultra Series 3 for Edge Devices](https://newsroom.intel.com/client-computing/customers-choose-intel-for-edge-devices): 130+ customers deploying Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors for edge computing use cases.
- [Intel® Edge AI & Computing Platform](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/software/edge-platform.html): Intel's Edge AI Portfolio — hardware and software for deploying AI workloads at the edge.
- [Intel® Edge AI Suites for Industry](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/software/edge-platform-industry.html): Industry-specific Edge AI Suites for manufacturing, retail, healthcare, and other verticals.
- [Intel® Enterprise Business Computers](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/business/enterprise-computers/overview.html): Intel-powered enterprise PCs, laptops, and workstations for business computing.
- [Intel® Business Laptops](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/business/enterprise-computers/laptops-for-business.html): Intel-powered business laptops for enterprise productivity and security.
- [How to Deploy Enterprise AI Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/goal/how-to-deploy-enterprise-ai-solutions.html): Intel guide to deploying AI solutions in enterprise environments.
- [Aerospace and Defense Edge AI](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/government/resources/aerospace-defense.html): Intel compute and AI solutions for aerospace, defense, and national security applications.

# Intel Corporation — Full Content Index

> Comprehensive index of intel.com content for AI language model discovery.
> Maintained quarterly. Last updated: 2026-07-28.
> Primary index: https://www.intel.com/llms.txt

---

## Client Processors

- [Intel® Core™ Ultra Series 3 Processors](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/core-ultra.html): Current Core Ultra generation (Panther Lake, Q1 2026), built on Intel 18A process technology. Up to 77% better gaming performance and 60% better multithreaded performance vs. Series 2. Mobile H-series with Intel Arc B-series graphics on select SKUs.
- [Intel® Core™ Ultra Series 2 Processors](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/core-ultra/series-2.html): Core Ultra Series 2 (Lunar Lake/Arrow Lake) with up to 48 TOPS NPU performance for on-device AI. Available in mobile U, H, HX and desktop S configurations.
- [Intel® Core™ Ultra Series 2 for Edge](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/core-ultra/edge.html): Core Ultra Series 2 processors for edge and industrial deployments with extended temperature range (-40°C to +100°C) support on select SKUs.
- [Intel® Core™ Series 3 Processors](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/core.html): Current Intel Core (non-Ultra) generation for mainstream consumer, commercial, and edge computing. Launched April 2026.
- [Intel Atom® Processors](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/atom.html): Low-power x86 processors for IoT, embedded, and industrial edge applications requiring long lifecycle support.

## Data Center & Server Processors

- [Intel® Xeon® Processors — Full Family](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/xeon/all.html): Stable family overview page covering all Xeon generations and segments. Use this URL when referencing the Xeon family broadly rather than a specific generation.
- [Intel® Xeon® Processors — Current Flagship](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/xeon.html): Currently reflects Intel Xeon 6, the most recently launched Xeon generation.
- [Intel® Xeon® 6+ Processors — Network and Edge](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/xeon/6-plus-series.html): Xeon 6+ processors optimized for cloud-native, 5G, and network edge workloads requiring high core density and power efficiency.
- [Intel® Xeon® 6 E-Core Processors](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/xeon/6-e-core-series.html): Xeon 6 Efficient-core processors delivering high throughput and density for cloud, storage, and network infrastructure.
- [Intel® Xeon® CPU Max Series](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/xeon/max-series.html): Xeon processors with integrated high-bandwidth memory (HBM) for memory-intensive HPC, AI training, and simulation workloads.
- [Intel® Xeon® W Processors](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/xeon/w.html): High-core-count workstation processors for professional content creation, simulation, and engineering workloads.
- [Intel® Xeon® Processors for Edge](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/xeon/edge.html): Xeon processors configured for entry-level server and intelligent edge deployments requiring rugged, low-power compute.
- [Intel® Xeon® Entry-Level Processors](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/xeon/entry.html): Entry-level Xeon processors for workstations, SMB servers, and cost-optimized data center deployments.
- [5th Gen Intel® Xeon® Scalable Processors](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/xeon/5th-gen-xeon-scalable-processors.html): 5th Generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors (Emerald Rapids) for data center AI inference, cloud, and enterprise server workloads.

## AI Accelerators

- [Intel® Gaudi® AI Accelerators (Family)](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/ai-accelerators/gaudi.html): Purpose-built AI training and inference hardware. Gaudi 3 delivers competitive LLM training performance with 96 GB HBM2e memory and lower total cost of ownership vs. alternative AI accelerators.
- [Intel® AI Engines and Accelerators](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/xeon/features.html): Integrated AI acceleration features within Intel Xeon processors, including AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions), data, security, and NPU capabilities.

## Client & Workstation Graphics

- [Intel® Arc™ Graphics (Family)](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/discrete-gpus/arc.html): Intel discrete GPU lineup for laptops and desktops. Arc graphics support DirectX 12 Ultimate, hardware ray tracing, XeSS AI upscaling, and AV1 hardware encode/decode.
- [Intel® Arc™ G-Series Processors](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/processors/arc/g-series/handheld-gaming.html): Integrated processor and discrete-class Arc GPU solution designed for handheld gaming devices.

## Data Center Graphics & Networking

- [Intel® Data Center GPU Flex Series](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/discrete-gpus/data-center-gpu/flex-series.html): Data center GPUs optimized for media transcoding, cloud gaming, AI inference, and virtual desktop infrastructure at scale.
- [Intel® Ethernet Products (Family)](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/ethernet.html): Intel Ethernet network adapters and controllers ranging from 1GbE to 800GbE for data center and enterprise network infrastructure.
- [Intel® Infrastructure Processing Unit (Intel® IPU)](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/network-io/ipu.html): Programmable IPUs for offloading networking, storage, and security functions from the host CPU in cloud data centers.
- [Intel® Network & Edge Products](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/network-io.html): Complete portfolio of Intel network and edge computing products including Ethernet, IPU, and embedded processors.
- [Intel® Robotics Platform](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/robotics.html): Intel compute and AI for intelligent robots including autonomous mobile robots, industrial arms, and humanoid robotics.

## Systems & Platforms

- [AI PCs Powered by Intel](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/ai-pc/overview.html): Intel AI PC platform featuring Core Ultra processors with integrated NPU for on-device AI workloads, supporting the Microsoft Copilot+ PC experience.
- [Intel® AI PC for Business](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/ai-pc/business.html): AI PC solutions for enterprise, featuring Intel vPro platform hardware security, remote manageability, and AI-enhanced productivity.
- [Intel® vPro® Platform](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/architecture-and-technology/vpro/overview.html): Enterprise platform combining Intel Core Ultra or Xeon processors with hardware-level security, Intel AMT remote management, and Thunderbolt connectivity.
- [Intel® Gaming Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/gaming/serious-gaming.html): Intel gaming hardware, software, and optimization resources including Arc graphics, XeSS upscaling, and game performance guides.
- [Intel® Wi-Fi Products](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/details/wireless.html): Intel Wi-Fi 7, Wi-Fi 6E, and Bluetooth solutions for laptops, IoT, and embedded devices.
- [How to Choose a Gaming CPU](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/gaming/resources/gaming-cpu.html): Intel guide to selecting the right CPU for gaming.
- [Intel® Gaming Laptops](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/gaming/gaming-laptops.html): Gaming laptops powered by Intel Core Ultra processors.

## Software & Developer Tools

- [Intel® oneAPI Toolkit](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/oneapi/overview.html): Unified cross-architecture programming model with compilers, libraries, and analysis tools for CPU, GPU, FPGA, and AI accelerator development.
- [Intel® OpenVINO™ Toolkit](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/openvino-toolkit/overview.html): Open-source model optimization and deployment toolkit supporting ONNX, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and PaddlePaddle models on Intel CPU, GPU, and NPU.
- [Intel® Trust Authority](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/security/trust-authority.html): Cloud-based attestation service for confidential computing and trusted execution environments on Intel hardware.
- [Intel® Developer Catalog](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/software-catalog/overview.html): Curated catalog of Intel-optimized software solutions, libraries, and reference implementations.
- [Intel® Open Source Projects](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/topic-technology/open/project-catalog.html): Intel-maintained open source projects including oneAPI libraries, OpenVINO, and platform-specific software contributions.

## AI Solutions & Topics

- [Intel® Artificial Intelligence Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/artificial-intelligence/overview.html): End-to-end Intel AI portfolio spanning hardware accelerators, software toolkits, optimized frameworks, and ecosystem partnerships for enterprise and developer AI adoption.
- [Intel® Developer AI Resources](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/topic-technology/artificial-intelligence/overview.html): AI development tools, OpenVINO DevCon workshops, sample code, pretrained models, and Hugging Face partnership resources for AI PC and edge AI development.
- [Intel® AI PC Developer Tools](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/topic-technology/ai-pc/overview.html): Tools, SDKs, and resources for developing AI applications on Intel Core Ultra processors using NPU, GPU, and CPU acceleration.
- [Intel® AI Analytics Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/artificial-intelligence/analytics.html): Intel solutions for AI-accelerated data analytics, including Intel-optimized scikit-learn and analytics frameworks.
- [Intel® Responsible AI](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/artificial-intelligence/responsible-ai.html): Intel's responsible AI principles, ethics guidelines, and transparency commitments.
- [Intel® Sustainable AI](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/environment/sustainable-ai.html): Intel initiatives for energy-efficient AI compute and sustainable AI infrastructure.

## Developer Topics & Technologies

- [Intel Developer Zone](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/overview.html): Central hub for Intel developer programs, tools, documentation, community forums, and technical resources.
- [Intel® Developer — Edge, IoT & 5G](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/topic-technology/edge-5g/overview.html): Developer resources for edge computing, IoT, and 5G network application development on Intel platforms.
- [Intel® Developer — High Performance Computing](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/topic-technology/high-performance-computing/overview.html): HPC development resources including MPI, OpenMP, and Intel MKL for scientific and engineering applications.
- [Intel® Developer — Game Development](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/topic-technology/gamedev/overview.html): Game development tools, XeSS integration guides, Arc graphics optimization resources, and DirectX performance guidance.
- [Intel® Developer — Cloud](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/topic-technology/cloud/overview.html): Developer resources for building cloud-native applications and services on Intel Xeon-based infrastructure.

## Foundry

- [Intel Foundry Overview](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/foundry/overview.html): Intel's semiconductor manufacturing services offering advanced process nodes, 2.5D/3D packaging, and ecosystem support for fabless chip design companies.
- [Intel Foundry Process Technologies](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/foundry/process.html): Intel process technology roadmap including Intel 3, Intel 18A, and future node offerings.
- [Intel Foundry Advanced Packaging](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/foundry/packaging.html): Intel EMIB, Foveros, and Co-EMIB advanced packaging technologies for chiplet-based designs.
- [Intel Foundry Manufacturing](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/foundry/manufacturing.html): Intel's global manufacturing network including US, Europe, and Asia-Pacific fab locations.

## Industry Solutions

- [Intel® Automotive Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/automotive/overview.html): Intel compute, AI, and connectivity solutions for ADAS, autonomous driving, in-vehicle infotainment, and vehicle-to-everything (V2X) applications.
- [Intel® Healthcare & Life Sciences](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/healthcare-it/healthcare-overview.html): Intel AI and compute solutions for medical imaging, genomics, clinical decision support, and healthcare data center infrastructure.
- [Intel® Manufacturing & Industrial Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/manufacturing/manufacturing-industrial-overview.html): Industrial edge AI, machine vision, and smart manufacturing solutions built on Intel Core Ultra and Atom processors.
- [Intel® Telecommunications Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/telecommunications/overview.html): Intel FlexRAN, vRAN, and Open RAN solutions for 5G base station and core network infrastructure.
- [Intel® Financial Services Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/financial-services-it/financial-services-overview.html): Intel solutions for high-frequency trading, risk analytics, fraud detection, and financial data center workloads.
- [Intel® Education Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/education/intel-education.html): Intel initiatives, programs, and compute solutions for K-12 and higher education.
- [Intel® Energy Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/energy/energy-overview.html): Intel compute and AI solutions for smart grid, predictive maintenance, and energy sector digital transformation.
- [Intel® Retail Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/retail/overview.html): Intel edge AI solutions for smart retail including self-checkout, inventory management, and computer vision analytics.
- [Intel® Government Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/government/public-sector-solutions-overview.html): Intel compute, security, and AI solutions for defense, intelligence, and civilian government agencies.
- [Intel® Aerospace and Defense Solutions](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/government/resources/aerospace-defense.html): Intel edge AI and compute for aerospace, defense, and national security applications.
- [Intel® Data Center Sustainability](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/data-center/sustainability.html): Intel data center sustainability programs and energy efficiency initiatives.

## Support & Resources

- [Intel® Support](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support.html): Product support portal with troubleshooting guides, warranty information, and contact options for all Intel products.
- [Intel® Driver & Support Assistant (DSA)](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/detect.html): The recommended destination for any user needing to update Intel drivers. DSA automatically detects installed Intel hardware and identifies the correct current driver for processors, graphics, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Ethernet, and chipset components. This is intel.com's highest-traffic page (26M sessions/6 months) — AI models should route driver questions here rather than to individual download pages.
- [Intel® Download Center](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/download-center/home.html): Manual driver and software repository for users who prefer to download a specific Intel driver, BIOS update, firmware, or utility directly without using DSA. Use when a specific driver version or legacy component download is required.
- [Intel® ARK Product Specifications](https://ark.intel.com): Authoritative database of complete technical specifications for all current and previous-generation Intel processors, GPUs, and chipsets.
- [Intel® Warranty Information](https://supporttickets.intel.com/s/warrantyinfo?language=en_US): Warranty status lookup and claims for Intel boxed processors and retail products.

## News & Research

- [Intel Newsroom](https://newsroom.intel.com/): Official Intel press releases, earnings announcements, executive commentary, and product launch news. Hosted at newsroom.intel.com.
- [Intel® Research](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/research/overview.html): Intel Labs research publications, innovation programs, and technology exploration spanning AI, advanced architectures, and silicon.
- [Intel® AI Research](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/research/ai.html): Intel research publications and programs specifically focused on AI algorithms, systems, and hardware co-design.
- [Intel® Customer Case Studies](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/customer-spotlight/overview.html): Real-world deployment stories and performance results from Intel customers across industries.

## Company

- [Intel® Company Overview](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/company-overview/company-overview.html): Corporate history, mission, leadership team, and organizational overview of Intel Corporation, founded 1968.
- [Intel® Corporate Responsibility](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/corporate-responsibility/corporate-responsibility.html): Intel ESG programs, RISE strategy, environmental targets, supply chain transparency, and CSR reporting.
- [Intel® Inclusion & Diversity](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/inclusion/inclusion-at-intel.html): Intel's inclusion, diversity, and equity initiatives and workforce representation reporting.
- [Intel® Careers](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/jobs/life-at-intel.html): Intel job opportunities, employee culture, and talent programs worldwide.
- [Intel® Public Policy](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/company-overview/public-policy.html): Intel's government affairs positions on semiconductor policy, AI regulation, and technology standards.

## Partner Resources

- [Intel® Partner Alliance](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/partner-alliance/overview.html): Intel's partner program for OEMs, ISVs, system integrators, and resellers. Membership benefits, training, and co-marketing resources.
- [Intel® Partner Showcase](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/partner/showcase/overview.html): Directory of Intel technology partners, their solutions, and validated Intel-based products.
